Mix scrambled eggs into the rice mixture.
For salad: combine mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and vinaigrette in a bowl. Serve alongside the fried rice.
diet_title: Duck and Vegetable Fried Rice with Mixed Salad

ingridients:
1 duck breast
1 cup uncooked rice
Mixed salad ingredients: 
   - 2 cups lettuce
   - 1 cucumber
   - 1 bell pepper
   - 1 tomato
   - 1/4 red onion
instructions:
Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Season the duck breast with salt and pepper, then cook in a skillet over medium-high heat for 5 minutes on each side. Transfer the duck to the preheated oven and cook for an additional 10-15 minutes or until cooked through.
Cook the rice according to package instructions.
Chop all the salad ingredients and mix them in a large bowl.
Serve the cooked duck, rice, and mixed salad on separate plates.
diet_title: Duck, Rice, and Mixed Salad Breakfast

ingridients:
1 lb pork belly
2 medium beetroots
6 medium potatoes
2 tbsp olive oil
Salt and pepper to taste
Mixed salad greens
Vinaigrette dressing
instructions:
Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Peel and cut beetroots and potatoes into cubes.
Toss potatoes with half of the olive oil, salt, and pepper, then spread them on a baking sheet.
Wrap pork belly in aluminum foil and place it on another baking sheet.
Roast the potatoes for 45 minutes, then add beetroots and continue roasting for another 30 minutes or until tender.
Unwrap the pork belly and roast for an additional 15-20 minutes or until fully cooked.
Serve the roasted vegetables with sliced pork belly on a bed of mixed salad greens, drizzled with vinaigrette dressing.
diet_title: Roasted Pork Belly Lunch with Beetroot and Roasted Potatoes

ingridients:
1 lb pork mince
2 cups kale, chopped
2 cups broccoli florets
2 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp sesame oil
1 tbsp minced garlic
instructions:
Heat sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant.
Add pork mince, cook until browned.
Add kale and broccoli, stir fry for 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Stir in soy sauce, serve hot.

ingridients:
2 beef rump steaks
2 cups mixed vegetables (such as bell peppers, zucchini, and mushrooms)
1 head of lettuce
1/4 cup olive oil
Salt and pepper to taste
1/2 cup cherry tomatoes
1/4 red onion
1 avocado
2 tbsp balsamic vinegar
instructions:
Preheat grill or skillet to medium-high heat.
Season steaks with salt and pepper.
Grill steaks for 4-5 minutes per side, or until desired doneness.
In a large bowl, combine mixed vegetables, lettuce, cherry tomatoes, and red onion.
In a separate small bowl, whisk together olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
Pour dressing over salad ingredients and toss to coat.
Slice grilled steaks and serve on top of the salad.
diet_title: Grilled Vegetable and Beef Rump Steak Salad

ingridients:
1/2 cup rolled oats
1 cup mixed fruits (strawberries, blueberries, and banana)
2 tbsp chia seeds
1 cup almond milk
instructions:
Combine oats, mixed fruits, and chia seeds in a bowl.
Pour almond milk over the mixture.
Stir well and let sit for 10 minutes to allow chia seeds to expand.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.
